summary: Frontend-only verification of Market page revamp (Hot=Genius, New->Coming Soon) and Trade Settings upcoming banner. critical_code_review_comments: Hardcoded dates in frontend will keep going stale. Consider either (a) a utility that offsets launchAt relative to a baseline when expired, or (b) a backend endpoint returning upcoming coins so dates can be managed centrally.
WebSocket to Binance returns 451 (geo-blocked). Pre-existing issue unrelated to this change; live price falls back to REST stats OK.
